results.title: Gulveer Singh becomes 1st Indian to win two track and field medals in single edition of Commonwealth Games
results.description: Reigning Asian champion Gulveer, who had won a silver in the 10,000m on July 28, finished third in the 5000m with a time of 13 minute 24.95 seconds to complete a historic double on the concluding day of the athletics competition.

results.title: Cloudbursts hit Kishtwar, Shopian; schools closed in Chenab Valley
results.description: Cloudbursts struck the Chatroo area of Kishtwar district in the Jammu region and Shopian in south Kashmir on Saturday, triggering flashfloods, damaging houses, shops and other infrastructure.
